mapper.select: SELECT mq.id, mq.member_email, mq.quest_id, mq.status, mq.assigned_date, mq.completed_at, q.title, q.description, q.type, q.repeat_type, q.reward, q.urgency FROM tbl_member_quest mq JOIN tbl_quest q ON mq.quest_id = q.quest_id WHERE mq.member_email = #{email} AND mq.assigned_date = #{date} AND q.active = TRUE ORDER BY q.urgency DESC, mq.id ASC

SELECT mq.id, mq.member_email, mq.quest_id, mq.status, mq.assigned_date, mq.completed_at, q.title, q.description, q.type, q.repeat_type, q.reward, q.urgency FROM tbl_member_quest mq JOIN tbl_quest q ON mq.quest_id = q.quest_id WHERE mq.id = #{id} AND mq.member_email = #{email}
